newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends little changed in slack trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends little changed in slack trade.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee closed at its opening level of 56.40 to the dollar on Monday after staying in a narrow range on lack of commercial demand and speculative activity, dealers said.
The rupee, which closed at 56.45 on Friday, traded in a 56.32-56.43 range, dealers said.
"There was slight import covering and very, very little speculation," said a Hatton National Bank dealer.
He said dealers believed many wanted to sell the U.S. unit at around the 56.50 level.
Overnight call money closed at 15.50, down sharply from 18 percent on Friday, dealers said.
Money market liquidity improved after the Central Bank bought nearly 1.2 billion rupees worth of treasury bills last week, dealers said. There were no big borrowers either, they added.
